layers.description: Publish the V1.29.6.2 wrist-grip and V1.29.7 operational-rider APIs only once their boots finish (fixes the intermittent V1.30 boot crash)
RTT into V5 free road, real-time fixed-step loop, lite telemetry, throttled rider bridge
Implicit wheel spin, suspension end-of-travel physics, chain force routing (anti-squat), aerodynamics, rider feet-down support, impulse joint limits
Physical rider: segment masses, pelvis/torso posture servos with reactions at seat/pegs/bars, hang-off, tuck, weight shift, stand; drives legacy rider pose and aero posture
Rider-in-the-loop maneuver library (brake, stoppie, wheelie, launch, lean, slalom) for tests and console
